## Summary

Describe the user or agent workflow and the smallest complete change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build:web` (when applicable)
- [ ] focused `node --test` checks (when applicable)

## Release and privacy review

- [ ] No credentials, private task data, or browser state is included.
- [ ] Data migration, platform, signing, updater, and checksum impact is documented.
- [ ] English and Chinese user-facing docs remain equivalent when changed.
